goal: Log the canonical storage path of the active data directory during node startup
Helps users and developers analyzing saved debug logs verify the actual directory when using symlinks
agreement: No reviews or concept approvals yet
Prefers avoiding redundant separate log lines when no symlink is used (l0rinc)
Suggests printing the resolved location on the existing datadir log line (sedited)

categories.name: utils
why: P4 because it is a minor logging convenience for inspecting debug logs
Only benefits users or developers benchmarking across symlinked storage directories
Has no broader impact on node performance, stability, or correctness
